common.schema.json.title: OPMS common definitions
common.schema.json.description: Shared definitions reused by every OPMS object schema.

Version.description: Dataset or change-set version label, e.g. 2026-11-23.1.

LocalPoint.description: [x, y, z] metres in the facility frame (x east, y north, z up).

LocalPolygon.description: Corners in the facility frame, counter-clockwise. At least four points. The ring need not repeat the first point. z is the elevation of the level.

Geometry.description: Geometry in a local frame. Coordinates are LocalPoints.

TimeWindow.description: Local-time window in the site's IANA timezone.

VehicleLimits.description: Physical limits. The lowest value along a route wins.

ExternalRefs.description: Links to other standards' identifiers instead of copying their geometry.

apds_place_id.description: APDS Place id (Place > SubplaceElement > IdentifiedArea > Space hierarchy is reused, not duplicated).

maze_id.description: Reserved: identifier in a MAZE facility map (interoperability is an open question).

iso5206_id.description: Identifier in an ISO/TS 5206-1 core data model instance.

Provenance.description: Where a fact came from and when it was last confirmed.

contribution_ids.description: Contributions that support this record (crowdsourced features).

change_set_id.description: Change set that last touched this record.

Evidence.description: Per-feature multi-source evidence kept by the consolidating repository.

agreement_score.description: Weighted share of observations consistent with the consensus.

Lifecycle.description: Feature lifecycle. Retired features are announced by a tombstone in a ChangeSet.

LicenceTerms.description: Usage terms for a dataset, feature or contribution.

QualityTier.description: Declared quality for a facility or feature. Cars map their ODD to a minimum tier. Tier 2 and tier 3 are owner-verified or higher: the facility must include a verification with role owner, status confirmed, and dataset_version equal to the dataset version. The verification does not raise the tier by itself. It is required before those tiers may be declared. Drive edges and accessible paths on an owner-verified facility must carry a centreline.

ApprovalStatus.description: Facility owner or operator consent for mapping and use.

signage.description: Mapping or AVP signage is posted on site.

dispute_contact.description: Public contact for corrections or takedown (organisation role or URL).

Profile.description: Cumulative dataset profile. static-core is the default and requires no live data.

BayAccessibility.description: Accessible-bay attributes. Dimensions are as built; standard_ref says what the facility was designed or audited against.

standard_ref.description: e.g. AS 2890.6:2022 (verify the edition in force).

gradient_pct.description: Maximum gradient across the bay and shared zone.

headroom_m.description: Minimum headroom over the bay and its approach.

high_roof_van_ok.description: Headroom and approach suit high-roof wheelchair vans.

loading.description: Clear space for ramps and lifts.

permit_scheme.description: adps = Australian Disability Parking Scheme permit.

bollard.description: Bollard in the shared zone to keep it clear.

HandoverAccessibility.description: Accessibility of a drop-off or pick-up zone.

kerbside_transfer_space_m.description: Clear width beside the vehicle for a wheelchair transfer or ramp.

wait_time_allowance_s.description: Extra standing time allowed when a passenger needs assistance.

PublicationTerms.description: How openly the dataset is published so councils, disability organisations and non-AV apps can use it.

non_av_use_allowed.description: Usable by people driving themselves or being driven, not only by automated vehicles.

Verification.description: One check of a feature against the real place. Stores the review, not the evidence file. No personal data.

role.description: Reviewer role. An organisation role, not a person's name.

status.description: confirmed: matches the place. incorrect: the record is wrong. missing: not there on the ground. not-checked: explicitly skipped.

note.description: Short note. No names, plates or diagnoses.

evidence_ref.description: Pointer to evidence kept outside the map (audit id or URL). Not the evidence itself.

dataset_version.description: Dataset version the reviewer looked at.

conflict-case.schema.json.description: A recorded disagreement between observations and how it was resolved.

rule_applied.description: Short name of the rule used.
